business_summary.text: Ather Energy manufactures electric two-wheelers and charging infrastructure, selling scooters such as the 450 and Rizta, with software and service revenue streams.

lab.quote: Hosur capacity expansion happening right away, an incremental 6,000 units per month capacity that will go live this quarter -- later this quarter.

call_memory.quote: Hosur capacity expansion happening right away, an incremental 6,000 units per month capacity that will go live this quarter -- later this quarter.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Hosur capacity expansion is happening right away with an incremental 6,000 units per month capacity that will go live later this quarter.

lab.quote: AURIC Phase 1, an incremental 12,000 units per month incremental capacity that will go - - that will finish -- that will go live by Q2 FY28

call_memory.quote: AURIC Phase 1, an incremental 12,000 units per month incremental capacity that will go - - that will finish -- that will go live by Q2 FY28
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: AURIC Phase 1 incremental 12,000 units per month capacity will go live by Q2 FY28.

lab.quote: taking our total installed capacity up from 9.2 lakh units, which is where we were -- we would have been by, let's say, middle of next year to 11.4 lakh units by Q2 FY28.

call_memory.quote: taking our total installed capacity up from 9.2 lakh units, which is where we were -- we would have been by, let's say, middle of next year to 11.4 lakh units by Q2 FY28.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Total installed capacity will increase up from 9.2 lakh units to 11.4 lakh units by Q2 FY28.

lab.quote: Trial production is expected to start in the next few weeks. So very much on track for Q3 FY27. And we expect to finish our capex installation and hence, capacity installation by Q4 FY27.

call_memory.quote: Trial production is expected to start in the next few weeks. So very much on track for Q3 FY27. And we expect to finish our capex installation and hence, capacity installation by Q4 FY27.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: AURIC Phase 1 trial production is expected to start in the next few weeks and finish capex installation by Q4 FY27.

lab.quote: Structurally, we have seen some gains, which is sustainable price hikes, VAVE work the teams have taken, cost reduction the teams have driven across the board. All of that put together has given us a 5.3% improvement in gross margin.

call_memory.quote: Structurally, we have seen some gains, which is sustainable price hikes, VAVE work the teams have taken, cost reduction the teams have driven across the board. All of that put together has given us a 5.3% improvement in gross margin.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Sustainable price hikes, VAVE work, and cost reduction gave a 5.3% improvement in gross margin compared to Q4 FY26.

lab.quote: Commodity inflation has come much worse than we would have liked, at a 9.4% hit to gross margins overall.

call_memory.quote: Commodity inflation has come much worse than we would have liked, at a 9.4% hit to gross margins overall.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Commodity inflation caused a 9.4% hit to gross margins overall in Q2 FY27.

lab.quote: But very smart SKU management by the teams have yielded and has created - - essentially opened up a new lever for us in the business, and it's improved margins by 2.7% in Q2.

call_memory.quote: But very smart SKU management by the teams have yielded and has created - - essentially opened up a new lever for us in the business, and it's improved margins by 2.7% in Q2.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Smart SKU management improved margins by 2.7% in Q2 FY27.

lab.quote: Netting out Q2 FY27 AGM at 24%, which is a 1.6% improvement over Q1 FY27, I think roughly, yes. Overall, H1 FY27 AGM is at 23%.

call_memory.quote: Netting out Q2 FY27 AGM at 24%, which is a 1.6% improvement over Q1 FY27, I think roughly, yes. Overall, H1 FY27 AGM is at 23%.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Q2 FY27 gross margin (AGM) was reported at 24% and H1 FY27 AGM at 23%.

lab.quote: EBITDA showing a 1,450 bps improvement year-on-year, from minus 9.6% in Q2 FY26 to positive 4.9% in Q2 FY27.

call_memory.quote: EBITDA showing a 1,450 bps improvement year-on-year, from minus 9.6% in Q2 FY26 to positive 4.9% in Q2 FY27.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: EBITDA improved by 1,450 bps year-on-year from minus 9.6% in Q2 FY26 to positive 4.9% in Q2 FY27.

lab.quote: That number for Q2 FY27 came in at INR164,000, so INR14,000 increase in average ex-showroom price.

call_memory.quote: That number for Q2 FY27 came in at INR164,000, so INR14,000 increase in average ex-showroom price.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Weighted average ex-showroom price increased from INR150,000 in Q4 FY26 to INR164,000 in Q2 FY27.

lab.quote: Wholesale volume grew from 65,000 units same time last year to 93,000 units in Q2, 42% growth year-on-year.

call_memory.quote: Wholesale volume grew from 65,000 units same time last year to 93,000 units in Q2, 42% growth year-on-year.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Wholesale volume grew 42% year-on-year from 65,000 units in Q2 FY26 to 93,000 units in Q2 FY27.

lab.quote: registrations, up from 57,000 units last -- same time last year to 92,500 units, almost 60% growth year-on-year.

call_memory.quote: registrations, up from 57,000 units last -- same time last year to 92,500 units, almost 60% growth year-on-year.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Registrations grew almost 60% year-on-year from 57,000 units to 92,500 units in Q2 FY27.

lab.quote: manufacturing capacity, which has gone up from 28,000 units average per month last quarter to 33,000 units average per month in Q2 FY27.

call_memory.quote: manufacturing capacity, which has gone up from 28,000 units average per month last quarter to 33,000 units average per month in Q2 FY27.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Manufacturing capacity increased from an average of 28,000 units per month in Q1 to 33,000 units per month in Q2 FY27.

lab.quote: What's also been very successful is AtherStack Pro attach rate, which came in at 94% for Q2 FY27 and non-vehicle revenue, which came in at 15% overall.

call_memory.quote: What's also been very successful is AtherStack Pro attach rate, which came in at 94% for Q2 FY27 and non-vehicle revenue, which came in at 15% overall.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: AtherStack Pro attach rate came in at 94% for Q2 FY27.

lab.quote: non-vehicle revenue, which came in at 15% overall.

call_memory.quote: non-vehicle revenue, which came in at 15% overall.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Non-vehicle revenue came in at 15% overall for Q2 FY27.

lab.quote: And preorders were up at about 108% year-on-year, hitting about 1.8 lakh preorders in Q2 FY27.

call_memory.quote: And preorders were up at about 108% year-on-year, hitting about 1.8 lakh preorders in Q2 FY27.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Preorders were up 108% year-on-year, hitting about 1.8 lakh preorders in Q2 FY27.

lab.quote: Ather inquiries were up even more at about 109%, crossing 10 lakh inquiries for Q2 FY27.

call_memory.quote: Ather inquiries were up even more at about 109%, crossing 10 lakh inquiries for Q2 FY27.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Ather inquiries were up 109%, crossing 10 lakh inquiries for Q2 FY27.

lab.quote: industry registrations hitting a growth of 82% year-on-year, netting out at about 6 lakh sales for the entire quarter.

call_memory.quote: industry registrations hitting a growth of 82% year-on-year, netting out at about 6 lakh sales for the entire quarter.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Industry registrations hit a growth of 82% year-on-year, netting out at about 6 lakh sales for the entire quarter.

lab.quote: Q2 was the first quarter when pan-India E2W penetration crossed 10%, netting out at about 11.2% for the full quarter.

call_memory.quote: Q2 was the first quarter when pan-India E2W penetration crossed 10%, netting out at about 11.2% for the full quarter.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Pan-India E2W penetration crossed 10%, netting out at about 11.2% for the full quarter.

lab.quote: we do believe that this is still supply constrained at an industry level, and the coming quarters should continue to remain fairly healthy for the entire industry.

call_memory.quote: we do believe that this is still supply constrained at an industry level, and the coming quarters should continue to remain fairly healthy for the entire industry.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Management expects demand to remain supply constrained at an industry level and coming quarters to remain fairly healthy.

call_points.text: AURIC Phase 1 trial production expected in the next few weeks, with full capex installation complete by Q4 FY27.
Management estimates ~20,000 units per month of unmet retail demand due to current store capacity limitations.
Weighted average ex-showroom price rose ₹14,000 to ₹164,000 in Q2 FY27 vs Q4 FY26, driven by price hikes and SKU mix.
AtherStack Pro attach rate reached 94% in Q2 FY27, with non-vehicle revenue at 15% of total revenue.
Commodity inflation in aluminium, copper, plastics, and memory was worse than anticipated, exerting a 9.4% drag on gross margins.
Launched mainstream scooter Konarc with 5th gen Bedrock battery (10-year warranty) and proprietary AeBS braking.
Overall volumes grew almost 66% in FY26, with Q4 delivering 83,000 units driven by the Rizta product.

operating_notes.text: FY26 COGS per unit fell 9% YoY to ₹1,10,199, lifting adjusted gross margin to 24% from 19%.
Q4FY26 market share was 18.6% (excluding Telangana for Mar'26), up 1,100 bps from Q1FY25.
Factory 3.0 at AURIC will have 10 lakh units a year, with Phase-I (5 lakh) commencing in Q3FY27.
Q4 FY26 Pro-Pack attach rate reached an all-time high of 93%.
Rizta crossed 3 lakh unit sales milestone within two years of launch, accounting for 76% of FY26 sales.
Incorporated wholly owned subsidiary Ather Insurance Limited for corporate agent business.
Wholesale volume grew 81% YoY to 83,000 units in Q1FY27, with registrations up 102% to over 90,000 units.
Adjusted gross margin fell to 22.4% in Q1FY27 from 25.4% in Q4FY26 due to a 46% rise in commodity index over five quarters.
Dealer inventory fell to 3 days from 14 days; management estimates 13,000-15,000 units of unmet monthly demand.
Consolidated results include Ather Insurance Limited and Ather Energy Hong Kong Limited from their respective incorporation dates.
Approved ₹122 Cr capex to expand Hosur capacity by 75,000 units and Factory 3.0 capacity by 150,000 units.
Q2FY27 consolidated results include Ather Insurance Limited and Ather Energy Hong Kong Limited from incorporation.
Average ex-showroom price rose to ₹164,000 in Q2 FY27 from ₹150,000 in Q4 FY26.
Non-vehicle revenue constituted 15% of total revenue in Q2 FY27, led by AtherStack Pro (>50% of non-vehicle).
Management estimates approximately 20,000 units per month of unmet retail demand due to capacity constraints.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹1,174.66 Cr (+73.7% YoY), net loss ₹100.23 Cr (against a loss of ₹234.4 Cr a year earlier).
FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹3,672 Cr (+63% YoY), loss ₹517 Cr (against ₹812 Cr), EBITDA margin -7%; Factory 3.0 Phase-I due to commence in Q3FY27.
Ather Energy Limited’s earnings call for Q4-FY2025-26, held May 04, 2026, audio recording available at media.atherenergy.com.
Ather Energy reported Q4 FY26 standalone revenue of ₹1,174.66 Cr with a net loss of ₹100.23 Cr.
Ather Energy announced that its Rizta family scooter crossed the 3 lakh unit sales milestone.
Ather Energy incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary, Ather Insurance Limited, for its insurance corporate agent business.

Ather Energy reported Q1FY27 wholesale volume of 83,000 units (up 81% YoY) and its first positive EBITDA of ₹9 Cr, with a ₹1,300 Cr QIP closed and a further ₹1,200 Cr preferential issue pending shareholder approval.
Ather Energy's wholly owned subsidiary Ather Insurance received IRDAI approval to act as a Corporate Agent for insurance distribution.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,464.24 Cr, net profit ₹1.26 Cr.
Ather Energy approved ₹122 crore capex to expand annual manufacturing capacity at its Hosur and Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar facilities.
Ather Energy reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹1,464.24 Cr and net profit of ₹1.26 Cr, with a board-approved ₹122 Cr capex for capacity expansion.
Audio recording of Earnings Call for quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 is available on the Company’s website.
Ather Energy: Monitoring agency report shows ₹1,364 Cr utilised from IPO proceeds as of Sep 2026
In Q2FY27 concall, Ather Energy announced an installed capacity target of 11.4 lakh units by Q2FY28 and achieved quarterly operating EBITDA breakeven.
